body_lead: India's Best Colleges 2026 ADVERTISEMENT Odisha rolls out AI course for apprenticeship degree students Odisha will replace the Good Citizenship course with ‘AI for All’ for AEDP students in 2026-27, helping them learn basic AI skills and prepare for industry apprenticeships. Odisha will add an ‘AI for All’ course for students studying under the Apprenticeship Embedded Degree Programme (AEDP). It will replace the Good Citizenship course in the second semester of the 2026-27 academic year, an official said on Thursday.
